justifications.durability: reverting any of the three sites to bare flock reddens tests/test_recovery_store_locks_hold_across_nodes.py::waits_for_holder, which the base-revision negative control shows by failing all three at ffcba6679c.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_recovery_store_locks_hold_across_nodes.py holds a second-process record-lock holder in front of each site and the logged base run fails all three (gates head-suite-template.log 58 passed, negative-control-base-revision.log 3 failed), so the measure is shown to discriminate rather than merely pass.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/resumption.py:554-557 and :2407-2410 leave four blank lines where the deleted context managers stood, so ruff format --check fails on the head file where it passed on the base file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:243 and reckon/crew/resumption.py:703 and :2438 each hand over to reckon.node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock, so all three locks the goal names take the cross-node primitive.
justifications.reuse: each site extends the repository's existing reckon/node_exclusive_lock.exclusive_lock owner and the two single-caller wrappers are deleted; the cross-process holder helper has no prior owner (tests/test_a_plan_state_lock_holds_on_every_node.py:_posix_lock_attempt only takes and releases in one shot, it does not hold a lock across a window).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the two commits (reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py, reckon/crew/resumption.py, tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, tests/test_recovery_store_locks_hold_across_nodes.py, the evidence fragment) is inside the node's declared write paths.
